gloss: way of speaking; manner of speech

definitions.gloss: way of speaking; manner of speech; how one talks
definitions.explanation: The style, tone, or manner in which a person speaks. Encompasses word choice, speed, intonation, and overall delivery. Composed of 話し (speaking) + 方 (way/method).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{話|はな}し{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧だ。
examples.english: Her way of speaking is very polite.

examples.japanese: {話|はな}し{方|かた}ひとつ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The impression you make changes dramatically with how you speak.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{話|はな}し{方|かた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけた→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should be careful about how you speak to your superiors.

notes:
USAGE:
{話|はな}し{方|かた} is a very common compound following the productive ～⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way of doing ~) pattern. It can refer to both the content and delivery of speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ (good at speaking)
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ (change one's way of speaking)
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ (be careful about how one speaks)
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧ (public speaking class)
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧ (tips for speaking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧ refers to the tone of voice or manner of speaking and focuses on how words sound. ⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧ means "way of saying" or "phrasing" and focuses more on word choice. ⟦{話術|わじゅつ}→話術：21732_wajutsu⟧ means "art of conversation" or "eloquence."
